decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution serves government e-borders and over 30 APIS schemes, so it is a core, sticky revenue line that the firm has every reason to keep.
The cyber security awareness module is low-cost to maintain, fits the firm's certified training business and meets growing compliance demand, though it gets little prominence on the website.
Behaviour analysis draws on the firm's specialist aviation security expertise and supports its strategy of combining technology with trained personnel.
Passenger profiling is an established aviation security competence built into the firm's airport and airline services, so withdrawing it is unlikely.
The travel and document verification platform has its own page and meets continuing airline compliance needs, and it may absorb demand left by the withdrawn travel health API.
